semiconductor_relevance: High — AGRU Pipeline Technology specializes in high-performance plastic piping systems essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: AGRU Pipeline Technology (Jiangsu) Co., Ltd. provides high-performance plastic piping solutions critical for semiconductor fabs, focusing on ultrapure water and chemical handling systems. Their products ensure minimal contamination and reliable conveyance of etchants and slurries, supporting advanced semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: PVDF piping systems for ultrapure water distribution
Automated IR fusion welding for high-integrity joints
PCW systems for safe conveyance of chemicals

regional_presence.China: AGRU has a production base in Jiangsu, enhancing their commitment to the Chinese market with localized supply and R&D.
